ev.q: Among 10,152 program participants, 757 (7.5%) were HBsAg-positive, indicative of chronic HBV infection
Among 273 household contacts of HBsAg-positive participants, 39 (14%) had positive test results for HBsAg
78% of persons with chronic HBV infection were linked to care using community-based services
HBsAg-positive persons who had health insurance were more likely to receive HBV-directed care than were those who were uninsured
This report describes each program’s operational services
A descriptive analysis was performed, and odds ratios with 95% confidence intervals were calculated using logistic regression.
